violation_type.title: Written Activity Plan - Engage in Outdoor and Active Play if more than One Caregiver (26 TAC §747.2104(c)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Written Activity Plan - Engage in Outdoor and Active Play if more than One Caregiver
violation_type.typical_finding: The children are not able to utilize the backyard for outdoor play, and are primarily playing indoors.
